A CRIPPLE boy was sitting in a box on four low wheels, in a little room in a small street in Westminster; his age was some fifteen or sixteen years; his face was clear-cut and intelligent, and was altogether free from the expression either of discontent or of shrinking sadness so often seen in the face of those afflicted.

arxiv-2108-02668.title: Covariance Estimation and its Application in Large-Scale Online Controlled Experiments
arxiv-2108-02668.creator: Tao Xiong, Yihan Bao, Penglei Zhao, and Yong Wang
arxiv-2108-02668.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Tao Xiong, Yihan Bao, Penglei Zhao, and Yong Wang. During the last few decades, online controlled experiments (also known as A/B tests) have been adopted as a golden standard for measuring business improvements in industry. In our company, there are more than a billion users participating in thousands of experiments simultaneously, and with statistical inference and estimations conducted to thousands of online metrics in those experiments routinely, computational costs would become a large concern.

arxiv-2203-02325.creator: Tian Huang, Jun Xu, Tao Luo, Xiaozhe Gu, Rick Goh, Weng-Fai Wong
arxiv-2203-02325.description: Abstract Quantum(-inspired) annealers show promise in solving combinatorial optimisation problems in practice. There has been extensive researches demonstrating the utility of D-Wave quantum annealer and quantum-inspired annealer, i.e., Fujitsu Digital Annealer on various applications, but few works are comparing these platforms.

arxiv-2207-10890.description: Abstract We performed feasibility studies for various single transverse spin measurements that are related to the Sivers effect, transversity and the tensor charge, and the Collins fragmentation function. The processes studied include semi-inclusive deep inelastic scattering (SIDIS) where single hadrons (pions and kaons) were detected in addition to the scattered DIS lepton.

arxiv-2209-08116.creator: Rounak Meyur
arxiv-2209-08116.description: Abstract Critical infrastructures are defined as those physical and cyber-based systems that are essential to the minimum operations of the economy and the government [ 1 , 2 ] . Since they provide crucial support for the delivery of basic services to almost all segments of society, they form the backbone of any nation’s economy.

arxiv-2310-02809.title: Persistence and neutrality in interacting replicator dynamics Thanks: This work was funded by project FONDECYT 1200925 The emergence of ecologies through metabolic cooperation and recursive organization , Centro de Modelamiento Matemático (CMM), Grant FB210005, BASAL funds for centers of excellence
arxiv-2310-02809.creator: Leonardo Videla 1, Mauricio Tejo 2, Cristóbal Quiñinao 3, Pablo A. Marquet 3,4, Rolando Rebolledo 5
arxiv-2310-02809.description: Abstract . We study the large-time behavior of an ensemble of entities obeying replicator-like stochastic dynamics with mean-field interactions as a model for a primordial ecology. We prove the propagation-of-chaos property and establish conditions for the strong persistence of the N N -replicator system and the existence of invariant distributions for a class of associated McKean-Vlasov dynamics.

arxiv-2310-07338.title: From Supervised to Generative: A Novel Paradigm for Tabular Deep Learning with Large Language Models Conference: Proceedings of the 30th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 25–29, 2024; Barcelona, Spain Proceedings of the 30th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Disco
arxiv-2310-07338.creator: Xumeng Wen, Han Zhang, Shun Zheng, Wei Xu, Jiang Bian
arxiv-2310-07338.description: Abstract . Tabular data is foundational to predictive modeling in various crucial industries, including healthcare, finance, retail, sustainability, etc. Despite the progress made in specialized models, there is an increasing demand for universal models that can transfer knowledge, generalize from limited data, and follow human instructions. These are challenges that current tabular deep learning approaches have not fully tackled.

arxiv-2403-18009.creator: N. Añez-López, U. Lebreuilly, A. Maury, P. Hennebelle
arxiv-2403-18009.description: Abstract Context. Only indirect evidence of the role of magnetic braking in regulating gravitational collapse and the formation of circumstellar disks, such as compact disk sizes and the launching of high-velocity collimated protostellar jets, has been found from observational work. Aims.

arxiv-2408-02643.creator: S. K. Jeena, Projjwal Banerjee
arxiv-2408-02643.description: Abstract Signature from Pop III massive stars of 140 140 – 260 ​ M ⊙ 260\,{\rm M_{\odot}} that end their lives as pair-instability supernovae (PISNe) are expected to be seen in very metal-poor (VMP) stars of [ Fe / H ] ≤ − 2 {\rm[Fe/H]}\leq-2 .

arxiv-2504-11242.title: Measurement of the g g factor of ground-state 87 Sr at the parts-per-million level using co-trapped ultracold atoms
arxiv-2504-11242.creator: Premjith Thekkeppatt, Digvijay, Alexander Urech, Florian Schreck, Klaasjan van Druten
arxiv-2504-11242.description: Abstract We demonstrate nuclear magnetic resonance of optically trapped ground-state ultracold 87 Sr atoms. Using a scheme in which a cloud of ultracold 87 Rb is co-trapped nearby, we improve the determination of the nuclear g g factor, g I g_{I} , of atomic 87 Sr by more than two orders of magnitude, reaching accuracy at the parts-per-million level.

arxiv-2509-19441.title: Efficient and optimal quantum state discrimination via quantum belief propagation
arxiv-2509-19441.creator: Christophe Piveteau, Joseph M. Renes
arxiv-2509-19441.description: Abstract \vskip-30.0pt We present an efficient quantum algorithm for a structured state discrimination problem we call the subspace decoding task . Building on this, we show that the algorithm enables efficient and optimal decoding of certain families of structured classical linear codes transmitted over binary-input classical–quantum pure-state channels.

arxiv-2512-15184.title: Continuous data assimilation for 2D stochastic Navier–Stokes equations
arxiv-2512-15184.creator: Hakima Bessaih, Benedetta Ferrario, Oussama Landoulsi and Margherita Zanella
arxiv-2512-15184.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hakima Bessaih, Benedetta Ferrario, Oussama Landoulsi and Margherita Zanella. Continuous data assimilation methods, such as the nudging algorithm introduced by Azouani, Olson, and Titi (AOT) [ 2 ] , are known to be highly effective in deterministic settings for asymptotically synchronizing approximate solutions with observed dynamics. In this work, we extend this framework to a stochastic regime by considering the two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations subject to either additive or multiplicative noise.

However, the clinical application of this approach has been hindered by a limited understanding of cfDNA biology.

pmc-11357050.title: Mapping Photogenerated Electron–Hole Behavior of Graphene Oxide: Insight into a New Mechanism of Photosensitive Pollutant Degradation
pmc-11357050.creator: Kaijie Ni, Yanlong Chen, Ruiqi Xu, Yuming Zhao, Ming Guo, Qingguo Shao
pmc-11357050.description: The use of graphene oxide (GO) photogenerated electron–hole (e–h+) pairs to degrade pollutants is a novel green method for wastewater treatment. However, the interaction between photosensitive pollutants and a GO–light system remains unclear. In this work, the mechanism of degradation of photosensitive pollutant tetracycline (TC) promoted by GO photogenerated e–h+ pairs was studied.

pmc-11523503.title: NHS national data opt-outs: trends and potential consequences for health data research
pmc-11523503.creator: John Tazare, Alasdair D Henderson, Jessica Morley, Helen A Blake, Helen I McDonald, Elizabeth J Williamson, Helen Strongman
pmc-11523503.description: BackgroundThe English NHS data opt-out allows people to prevent use of their health data for purposes other than direct care. In 2021, the number of opt-outs increased in response to government-led proposals to create a centralised pseudonymised primary care record database.AimTo describe the potential impact of NHS national data opt-outs in 2021 on health data research.

pmc-11532448.title: Double cyst duct in a young woman with a history of systemic lupus: A case report
pmc-11532448.creator: Salvador Carlos Jiménez, Miriam Natividad Jiménez Velázquez, Juan Carlos Rivera Nava, Raúl Alejandro Núñez Torres, Edgard Efrén Lozada Hernández, Jose Alaniz Ruiz
pmc-11532448.description: Introduction and importanceCholecystectomy is the most common general surgery procedure, necessitating thorough knowledge of bile duct anatomy. Despite the bile duct's anatomical diversity, reports of double cystic ducts are rare. This case presentation aims to emphasize the importance of recognizing this unusual anatomical variant during surgical procedures to prevent complications and ensure patient safety.

pmc-11546779.title: A Multifaceted Exploration of Status Asthmaticus: A Retrospective Analysis in a Romanian Hospital
pmc-11546779.creator: Adriana Ana Trusculescu, Versavia Maria Ancusa, Camelia Corina Pescaru, Norbert Wellmann, Corneluta Fira-Mladinescu, Cristian Iulian Oancea, Ovidiu Fira-Mladinescu, Russell Hopp
pmc-11546779.description: Background: Status asthmaticus is a severe, life-threatening asthma exacerbation requiring urgent medical intervention. This study aims to examine its epidemiology in Timis County, Romania, over 11 years. Methods: A retrospective analysis was conducted using hospital records from 2013 to 2023, focusing on demographic, geospatial, and temporal distributions.

pmc-11572400.title: Association of Biomarkers with the Severity of Depression
pmc-11572400.creator: Shruti Agnihotri, Suresh Daripelly, Shirley Keerthana Cherla, Ajay Kumar Jopaka, Umashankar Molanguri
pmc-11572400.description: Background:The pathogenesis of depression remains elusive and uncertain. The literature suggests that low-grade systemic inflammation might contribute to the etiology of depression. Other markers that are studied are serum magnesium and serum cortisol. The association between these factors might help understand the etiology.Methods:This was a cross-sectional study conducted on a sample of 40 participants.

pmc-11649292.title: The unmet needs for minimally invasive liver surgery training
pmc-11649292.creator: Ahmed Elgendi
pmc-11649292.description: rn minimally invasive procedures, has revolutionized the field of surgery over the past few decades. With its proven benefits of shorter hospital stays, reduced pain, and quicker recovery times, the demand for skilled laparoscopic surgeons is on the rise. Laparoscopic surgery training is critical for liver surgeons looking to specialize in minimally invasive procedures.

pmc-11669553.title: Efficient gaze stabilization during video Active Gaze Shift Test (vAGST) in bilateral vestibulopathy
pmc-11669553.creator: Christian Van Nechel, Ulla Duquesne, Michel Toupet, Charlotte Hautefort
pmc-11669553.description: IntroductionWhile most head movements in daily life are active, most tools used to assess vestibular deficits rely on passive head movements. A single gain value is not sufficient to quantify gaze stabilization efficiency during active movements in vestibular deficit patients. Moreover, during active gaze shifts, anticipatory mechanisms come into play.

pmc-12563957.title: Comparative Prognostic Roles of β-Catenin Expression and Tumor–Stroma Ratio in Pancreatic Cancer: Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy vs. Upfront Surgery
pmc-12563957.creator: Shu Oikawa, Hiroyuki Mitomi, So Murai, Akihiro Nakayama, Seiya Chiba, Shigetoshi Nishihara, Yu Ishii, Toshiko Yamochi, Hitoshi Yoshida
pmc-12563957.description: Simple SummaryPancreatic cancer is one of the most aggressive cancers, and doctors need better ways to estimate which patients may relapse after surgery. In this study, we analyzed tissue samples from 84 patients, some who received chemotherapy before surgery and some who went straight to surgery. Using computer-based imaging, we looked at several microscopic features.

pmc-12666164.title: Development and validation of a 10-year predictive model for cardiovascular and metabolic disease risk: insights from a large-scale health examination cohort
pmc-12666164.creator: Dejie Wang, Jiang-Shan Tan, Ruihan Liu, Yingjuan Ma, Yugang Han, Wei Gan, Yanmin Yang, Jian Cao
pmc-12666164.description: ObjectiveTo develop and validate a 10-year predictive model for cardiovascular and metabolic disease (CVMD) risk using comprehensive health examination data from nearly 37 701 individuals.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study used health examination data, including demographic information, clinical measurements, laboratory tests and lifestyle factors. Potential predictors were selected based on a literature review and exploratory analysis.

pmc-13135670.title: Integrative genomic and functional characterization of ADAMTS3 reveals its inflammatory regulation via NF‐κB and STAT3 pathways in osteosarcoma
pmc-13135670.creator: Ehed Muhammed Aymaz, Meltem Alper, Feyza Nur Sav, Tuğşen Aydemir, Feray Köçkar
pmc-13135670.description: Osteosarcoma (OS) is an aggressive bone malignancy characterized by genomic instability and extensive extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling. Members of the ADAMTS family are matrix‐associated proteases implicated in tumorigenesis; however, their roles in OS remain poorly defined. This study provides a comprehensive genomic, transcriptomic, and functional analysis of the ADAMTSs in OS, with particular focus on ADAMTS‐3.
